name: HivePunk 547
subject: RigoBlock v3-contracts
thesis: On the public pages read, this is a confirmed but low-priority missing-modifier issue that remains Open with no linked fix, so the current public status is unfixed and not directly exploitable as reported.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: RigoBlock/v3-contracts has 50 raw commits in the last 30 days, 21 of them real work (not docs, formatting, bots, templates or trivial).

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Its latest real commit is c75040b, on 2026-11-19.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: RigoBlock v3-contracts is described as Smart contracts of RigoBlock v3.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #1020 is titled Fix[Protocol]: missing non-reentrant modifier in modifyLiquidities and is shown as Open.
claims.quote: Open Open Fix[Protocol]: missing non-reentrant modifier in modifyLiquidities #1020

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The issue was opened on Nov 19, 2026 by gabririgo.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The issue body says modifyLiquidites does not have a non-reentrant modifier, is not directly exploitable, a malicious uniswap v4 hook could abuse it, and it is low priority as privileged-role-gated with no funds at risk.
claims.quote: method modifyLiquidites does not have non-reentrant modifier. It is not directly exploitable, but a malicious uniswap v4 hook could abuse it. Low priority as priviledged-role-gated and no funds at risk.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The issue page shows no development branches or pull requests linked to it.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Rigoblock V3 smart contracts are deprecated and not covered by the Program, as stated on the bug bounty page.
claims.quote: Rigoblock V3 smart contracts are deprecated and not covered by the Program.

claims.label: FACT

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: Whether the missing non-reentrant modifier has since been added to the code is unknown from the pages read.
claims.missing: A public commit, pull request, or release that adds the non-reentrant modifier to modifyLiquidities would verify whether the issue has been fixed.

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: Whether the affected contract is deployed and reachable by a malicious Uniswap v4 hook in production is unknown from the pages read.
claims.missing: A deployed contract address, chain, and code verification for the contract containing modifyLiquidities would verify live exposure.

risks: A malicious Uniswap v4 hook could abuse the missing modifier, per the issue reporter.
The issue is privileged-role-gated, so abuse may depend on privileged access rather than anyone being able to exploit it directly.
Rigoblock V3 smart contracts are described as deprecated and not covered by the current bug bounty program, which may affect incentives to fix or disclose further issues.
No fix branch or pull request was shown on the issue page, so the missing modifier may remain unpatched in the public code shown.
The issue does not name the affected contract, file, or deployed addresses, limiting assessment of live exposure.
unknowns: Whether the missing non-reentrant modifier has since been added to the code is unknown from the pages read.: A public commit, pull request, or release that adds the non-reentrant modifier to modifyLiquidities would verify whether the issue has been fixed.

Whether the affected contract is deployed and reachable by a malicious Uniswap v4 hook in production is unknown from the pages read.: A deployed contract address, chain, and code verification for the contract containing modifyLiquidities would verify live exposure.
wouldChangeMind: A merged commit or pull request adding the non-reentrant modifier to modifyLiquidities and closing #1020.
Verified deployment details showing the function is unreachable by external hooks or is not used in production.
Evidence that the issue was withdrawn, marked wontfix, or added to Known Issues with a documented mitigation.
